set.body: Add locus-data with IndexedField, Section, typed supported Parcellation, partition comparison, surjective coarsening, Searchlight with center support, centered evidence, and one-pass commutative foldMapBy. Use typed parcel points instead of arbitrary label equality and use Cats Kernel rather than a new monoid. Acceptance follows phase 3 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md, including fiber, coarsening, restriction, aggregation-fusion, allocation, JVM, and Scala.js gates.
set.title: Locus 3: parcellations, indexed fields, searchlights, and aggregation
